newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 4.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- United States president Bill Clinton sees his lead narrowed on eve of presidential election.

-- Lagardere chairman Jean-Luc Lagardere has been placed under legal investigation for alleged misappropriation of company funds linked to the structure which paid salaries to Lagardere managers, including himself.
-- SNCF rail operator and La Poste post office negotiate early retirements for workers aged 53 to 57 years.
-- Paribas may soon obtain license to open branch office in Shanghai.
